contract.text: At day completion the scheduler idles until a future next-day wake-up; it does not exit and get relaunched in a loop.
contract.source: commit 864d3aa message body; ARCHITECTURE.md at 4bd8193 'Daily lifecycle'; src/bts/scheduler.py _idle_until_next_wakeup docstring

mechanism.text: run_day step 7 computed the next wake with compute_wakeup_time(tomorrow_games), whose default path used datetime.now(ET) at the default hour - today's 10:00 ET, already past at day completion - so _idle_until_next_wakeup no-opped on a past wake, run_day returned, the process exited 0 and Restart=always relaunched it; before 20:00 ET the relaunch re-ran the same date and completed again

residual.text: No-games days still returned today's 10:00 from compute_wakeup_time([]) and thrashed ~30 s restarts (Fable-5 P2), fixed 736ea8f (6/09); the eve-of-break past wake recurred 7/12 (E75/I-075), fixed 9551818.
At HEAD _idle_until_next_wakeup still returns on an unset/malformed/past wake (loud WARNING, bounded churn by design).

watchdog.trigger: three or more clean scheduler exits/relaunches within 60 minutes outside a date transition, or a heartbeat IDLE_END_OF_DAY/SLEEPING whose sleeping_until is not in the future
watchdog.recovery_assertion: at day completion next_wakeup is on the next schedule date and in the future, and NRestarts stays flat until it
